library/getSteamLibraries/legacy.divergenceNote: legacy.vdf is the pre-2021 libraryfolders layout (index key -> path string). The old TS read folder.path off a string and got undefined, so it returned no libraries; Rust reads the legacy layout, which Steam itself still writes and reads, so Rust is Steam-correct.

library/getSteamLibraries/malformed.divergenceNote: The old parser threw on malformed libraryfolders.vdf and the throw escaped getSteamLibraries; the wrapper now fails soft to the system path only (parsed=false), which is the documented T-2-01 never-throw posture; the TS caller policy (system path first, existsSync filter) is unchanged.

library/getSteamLibraries/no-file.divergenceNote: The oracle threw only because the logger has no writer outside the sidecar (reading logDebug of undefined); with the logger present the missing-file branch logs and returns the system path, which the oracle filter strips. Rust matches the intended behaviour.

WR-02 (75 review): scan/lib1 holds the truncated appmanifest_30.acf, which the scan reports in skipped. findOtherManifestsWithInstalldir gates a recursive rmSync of the install directory, so a sibling manifest it could not read may be a co-installed app sharing the installdir and is reported as the '<unknown>' conflict (manifest-only removal) rather than ignored. The oracle fixture for this case did not include an unreadable sibling.
